source.buildCheck: Every compiled core file exists and is at least as recent as its TypeScript source; both content hashes recorded.

timing.timestamps: Events observed within each simulated second are assigned its end boundary.

method.input: Same as tests/balance.test.ts: 2 simultaneous keyboard inputs then tick(1000); 120s onboarding; idle=0 inputs afterward; intermittent=sec%60<15.
method.choice: Choose first offer immediately even while idle; optimistic attention model. No companion management. Optional paid policies buy whenever eligible/affordable; reroll once per offer.
method.independentSamples: 100+ distinct seeds per policy/profile. 5/15/30 minute checkpoints share a trajectory; profiles/policies reuse seeds for paired comparisons.
method.percentiles: Sort reached values ascending, take floor((n-1)*q). Report unreached separately; quantiles conditional on reaching are not a success claim.
method.meaningfulEvent: Observable proxy: levelUp, bossCaptured, first discovery of a monster species, or accepted hero choice. Ordinary kills/coins excluded. Multiple events can occur in one second; this is not enjoyment or attention.
method.gaps: Maximum gap includes initial waiting and trailing silence at each checkpoint. Discovery gap counts only new monster species.
method.damage: Cumulative emitted damage divided by modeled seconds, including overkill; not effective removed HP.
method.controls: pureIdleControl starts with no companions/input, one seed; it is separate from the 100-seed warm-idle distribution.
